regime_notes: Scores are flow-based and calibrated: October ETF flows (State Street, TD Securities, WGC, Trackinsight) were strong almost everywhere, but they predate the Nov 5 AI/semis shock and the oil war-premium unwind, so late-cycle chasing (energy, leveraged semis) is neutralised rather than scored +1. In-window market-level flows show a reallocation inside EM: record foreign selling in Taiwan and Korea concentrated in memory names, and a sharp FPI return to India. Bond ETFs took a record $74bn, concentrated in short/aggregate government, IG and munis; credit flow support is intact but HY spreads widened 16bp on Nov 5. Fund-level events are mechanical (EWY/EWS capped-index switch Nov 9, EWG/EWM Dec 1) or slow-burn (MSCI Indonesia standalone consultation); no closure, merger or fee hike was found for held UCITS funds or for KMLM, DBMF, AOM, MUB, MBB, HACK, EIDO. MSCI November review results (expected Nov 11) remain unverified.

red_flags.issue: Index change: iShares moves EWY (Korea) and EWS (Singapore) to MSCI 25/50 Daily 25 Capped indexes on or around 2026-11-09; any group entity above 25% between quarterly rebalances is trimmed to 22.5% (Samsung group in EWY). Mechanical rebalance trades, not a reason to switch.
Index change: move to MSCI 25/50 indexes on or around 2026-12-01 (same iShares, Inc. supplements).

MSCI consultation (Oct 15) on reclassifying Indonesia from Emerging to Standalone; MSCI expects to proceed unless governance improves (decision by 2027-06-30). Freeze on Indonesia FIF/NOS increases and IMI additions stays in place; HSC-flagged names keep being deleted. Small fund ($384m) traded at a +0.68% premium on Nov 6.

Positioning risk, not a fund change: SOXL took +$9.0bn in October and Korean retail net bought $4.28bn Oct 1-Nov 5 while it fell 73%. Leveraged daily-reset decay and forced de-risking risk if semis fall further.

Market-structure change: from Nov 9 Taiwan caps intraday short-sale orders of borrowed shares at 3% of 30-day ADV (from 30%) and raises short-sale margin to 130%; could raise AP hedging costs and widen EWT spreads/premiums. Stabilisation fund authorised Nov 6.

red_flags.target: KMLM, DBMF, AOM, MUB, MBB, HACK, EIDO
red_flags.issue: EDGAR full-text and issuer-page scan found no liquidation, merger, sub-adviser or index-change filing for these funds. KraneShares liquidated seven other funds (2x China single-stock, Asia bond) on 2026-10-29; iMGP DEF 14A is a trustee election only (meeting 2027-01-15). Low closure risk; volume spikes unexplained.
Favourable fee change: Vanguard FTSE All-World UCITS ETF OCF cut from 0.19% to 0.14%, effective 2026-07-28.
Context, not a fund event: largest passive equity outflow in October (-$6.9bn) while VOO (+$23.7bn) and SPYM (+$10.1bn) led inflows (fee-driven rotation).
Context, not a fund event: GLD -$1.8bn in October vs GLDM +$905m; US gold ETFs net -$0.7bn while global gold ETFs took +$2.7bn.
